content:
maria: quick heads-up — after the kernel tiling flip we rolled on Thursday, KV reuse across short prefix requests dropped noticeably. p50 token latency up ~18% on small prompts.

aj: which flip specifically? the attention tiling kernels? :eyes:

rowan: yes — kernel v3.2.1 (tiling + new matmul kernel). perf-bot posted a small flamegraph in #ci. looks like more page churn in the KV arena.

perf-bot: perf snapshot: https://perf.redwood.example/snap/5654320900 — flamegraph + heap-map attached.

samir: dug into heap maps — fragmentation increased and free-list scatter up. longctx runs are fine, but short multi-request flows (chat-style) lose prefix hits. suspect cache key variance + page-placement causing fewer co-residency hits.

maria: timeline — we also changed cache key derivation in runtime (tenant salt added) to avoid cross-tenant collisions. could be related.

aj: can you paste the old vs new key function?

rowan: old snippet:```python
# old
def cache_key(model_id, session_id, prefix_hash):
    return f"{model_id}:{session_id}:{prefix_hash}"
```

rowan: new snippet (what shipped):```python
# new
def cache_key(model_id, tenant_salt, session_id, prefix_hash):
    return f"{model_id}:{tenant_salt}:{session_id}:{prefix_hash}"
```

samir: that extra tenant_salt means identical prefixes from same model/session but different salts end up in different buckets — on tiled kernels different placement heuristics cause them to land on different pages, increasing fragmentation.

maria: proposal: canonicalize prefix before hashing and fold tenant_salt into namespace-level salt only when necessary. two changes: 1) normalize/truncate prefix before computing prefix_hash, 2) add optional session_hint header so follower requests can request sticky worker affinity.

aj: example canonicalization patch?

rowan: quick patch idea:```python
# canonicalize and limit key entropy
def normalize_prefix(prefix: str) -> str:
    p = " ".join(prefix.split())  # collapse whitespace
    p = p.lower()
    # remove punctuation that doesn't affect LM tokenization, heuristic
    p = re.sub(r"[^"]\w\s]", "", p)
    return p[:256]

def cache_key(model_id, tenant_salt, prefix):
    norm = normalize_prefix(prefix)
    prefix_hash = sha256(norm.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    return f"{model_id}:{prefix_hash}:{tenant_salt[:8]}"
```

samir: +1. also suggest moving tenant_salt lower in the key (so primary sharding by model+prefix) and using truncated salt so we don't explode key space. TTL bump for prefix entries from 5m->20m for short-chat can help reuse while we validate.

maria: sticky session hint: add X-Redwood-Session-Hint header that accepts a 64-bit affinity token. server will try to route to same worker for N requests. sample request:```http
POST /v1/generate
X-Redwood-Session-Hint: 0x1a2b3c4d
{ "model": "redwood-7b", "input": "hi" }
```

aj: routing + affinity still needs canary. we should not break multi-tenant isolation.

rowan: canary plan: 10% traffic on dedicated-4 pool with 3 changes toggled: key canonicalization, tenant_salt truncation, TTL=20m, and session-hint honored. metrics to watch: prefix hit-rate, p50/p95 token lat, resident set fragmentation (pages/scatter), and GC pauses.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: dedicated-4 / cohort=10% / start=2026-03-11T15:00Z / rollback=auto(>3% p50 reg).

samir: I'll prepare a lightweight tracer to emit cache_key and target page id (hashed page) — obfuscated keys only (no raw text). need to ensure PII-safe.

maria: thanks. please add an eval harness that replays short-followup chat patterns (1-4 token followups) — those are the worst hit.

aj: also flag the kernel team: if tiled placement keeps scattering small prefix hashes across pages, it might require a placement hint from the allocator (page affinity for hot prefixes). cc @kernel-team.

rowan: noted. I'll open a kernel ticket with traces and page-occupancy heatmap.

maria: action items: samir = tracer + heap diff script, rowan = canonicalization PR + unit tests, aj = canary dashboard, kernel-team = review placement heuristic. roll window 48h and decide. :thumbsup:

samir: starting tracer now. will share link when ready. :thumbsup:
